Taurus — 3rd (Cloth Ability) Technique, gained at level 11.

Aldebaran does not dodge. He stands where the blow was going.

Trigger An ally within 15 feet would be hit by an attack or targeted by a damaging effect.

You interpose yourself and become the target instead. You take the damage reduced by 10 plus twice your level, and you cannot be moved from your square by that effect.

Heightening (+2 levels) The reduction scales with your level automatically. At 15th and 19th level you may use this one additional time per round.

On a day your constellation is Ascendant this Technique heightens as though you were 4 levels higher; on a Zenith, 8 levels higher.
